name: Are there energy-efficient options for skylights?

mainEntity.name: Are there energy-efficient options for skylights?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many energy-efficient skylight options are available. These often feature low-emissivity (low-e) coatings, insulated glass (double or triple-pane), and inert gas fills like argon or krypton between panes. These features help to reduce heat transfer, keeping your home cooler in summer and warmer in winter. When making a comparison, consider the U-factor (heat loss) and Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC - solar radiation admitted) ratings; lower values generally indicate better energy performance and can lead to significant savings on utility bills.
acceptedAnswer.description: Energy-efficient skylights feature low-e coatings, insulated glass, and gas fills to reduce heat transfer and improve insulation.
